title: Deferred-decision trigger registry: .bee/triggers store, triggers add/list/resolve, orient blocker line
action:
Per plan v2 C2 (D2). New verbs/triggers module: store one JSON file per trigger at the CONTROL root .bee/triggers/__.json (control-root resolution like no_route_claim_counts_dir, handlers_write.rs:815-870; atomic write, fail-open read — a worktree session must hit the shared store, never a per-worktree copy). Record fields: id, decision (short8 of the deferring decision), condition (prose), tier (predicate|manual), optional predicate (path-exists:

| path-missing:

), status (waiting|due|resolved), created/updated dates, outcome (set on resolve). Verbs (wire into the dispatch table + registry_payload.json so registry_contracts.rs stays green): triggers add --decision --condition [--predicate ] (tier derived: predicate present => predicate, else manual); triggers list [--due] [--json] evaluating predicates on read — a true predicate flips waiting->due and persists (write-on-read precedent: sweep_on_orient, orient.rs:260-289); triggers resolve --id --outcome writes outcome+status into the record ONLY — it never logs a decision. Corrupt/unreadable trigger file: fail open to a visible line 'unreadable trigger — remedy: delete the file', never a crash, never silently skipped. Orient surfacing: one blocker line 'N trigger(s) due, M awaiting confirmation' via an Option helper in the blocker sequence (orient.rs:322-388, template capture_queue_blocker_line orient.rs:174-189), counting due + manual-waiting. Tests (module tests): add/list/resolve round-trip; predicate flip persists across reads; corrupt file yields the remedy line; orient line appears only when due or manual-waiting exists; store path resolves to control root when called from a linked worktree.

truths: a trigger with predicate path-exists flips to due exactly when the path exists, and the flip is persisted
manual-tier triggers never auto-fire; they surface as awaiting confirmation
resolve writes outcome into the record and logs no decision
a corrupt trigger file produces the delete-remedy line and never a crash
registry_contracts.rs is green with the new verbs registered
